name: The Search Continues
summary: The search for the Menethil Statuette continues among nearby Murloc hovels. These shelters hold no sign of it, so you turn to two more.

sections.title: Empty Hovels
sections.body: You search this cluster of Murloc hovels, but find no trace of the Menethil Statuette. Two nearby shelters to the north and northeast may hold clues.

faq.answer: You are searching for the Menethil Statuette.

faq.q: What do I find in these hovels?
faq.answer: You find no trace of the Menethil Statuette in this cluster of Murloc hovels.
Look in the nearby hovels to the north and northeast for more clues.
The barrel holds damp, pungent cheese that is still tasty.
